properties.displayName: Entra - Domain or Federation Settings Changed
properties.description:
DETECTS
Changes to domain authentication type, federation settings, or the addition and verification of a domain.

WHY IT MATTERS
This is the Golden SAML and AADbackdoor territory. Converting a domain to federated authentication, or adding a rogue federation trust, lets an attacker mint tokens for any user in the tenant without ever knowing a password or triggering MFA. It is among the most severe and most persistent attacks available against Entra ID, and it is very rarely a routine change (MITRE T1484, Domain Policy Modification).

TRIAGE
1. Treat as critical until proven otherwise. Confirm the actor identity and authorisation immediately.
2. Determine whether a domain moved between managed and federated authentication.
3. If a federation trust was added or altered, inspect the issuer and signing certificate for anything unfamiliar.
4. Verify against change management. Federation changes are major planned projects, never ad hoc.
5. If unauthorized: remove the trust, revoke all refresh tokens tenant-wide, and treat the entire tenant as compromised.

FALSE POSITIVES
Genuine federation migration and domain onboarding projects. These are rare, planned, and easily confirmed.

SOURCE
AuditLogs
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has_any ("Set domain authentication", "Set federation settings on domain", "Add unverified domain", "Verify domain", "Add domain to company")
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend DomainName = tostring(TargetResources.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, DomainName, OperationName, CorrelationId
| extend Account = Actor

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Domain or federation setting changed: {{DomainName}} by {{Actor}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Actor}} performed {{OperationName}} affecting domain {{DomainName}}, which can alter how the tenant trusts authentication.
